SALTGLASS - Episode 1: "Six Minutes" (720p, 12 parts)

Each part is a normal MP4 you can watch on its own (they are the
episode's 12 scenes in order). To join them into one file without
re-encoding:

  1. Put all 12 parts in one folder
  2. Create list.txt containing one line per file, in order:
       file 'SALTGLASS_E01_part01.mp4'
       ...
       file 'SALTGLASS_E01_part12.mp4'
  3. Run:
       ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i list.txt -c copy SALTGLASS_E01.mp4

Subtitles are burned in; episode.srt is also provided separately.
